verbs.name: screen_record.status
verbs.description: Read the short-lived first-screen-frame admission fact, capture-owned selected-source lifecycle, controller-placement conclusion, and bounded native-audio snapshots for one active capture in this cutd process. This is not crash recovery, output validation, a timer, or a process-start acknowledgement: ready becomes true only after the active native screen path delivered a real screen frame (Windows: accepted by the MP4 encoder; macOS: ScreenCaptureKit screen-sample callback; Linux: PipeWire screen buffer delivered through the GStreamer observer). source_lifecycle is source_lost only after a native backend observed its armed selected-source close signal before a Cut-owned close; generic Stop, duration expiry, encoder/disk failure, permission changes, and reservation removal never acquire that label. unavailable means this admitted source has no such defensible signal. controller_placement reports a real native exclusion/hide decision without window handles, process ids, or source identities: Windows requires WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE readback, macOS requires an admitted ScreenCaptureKit display filter excluding the owning Cut windows, and Linux portal capture remains unavailable when it cannot prove equivalent exclusion. Window capture preserves its exact selected-window semantics and therefore does not claim display-controller exclusion. Audio meters observe only the already-admitted microphone or system-audio stream and never select or open a device. Terminal, stale, and device_lost sources are not live even when a last packet remains visible. macOS system-audio metering is unavailable because the current Core Audio tap transfers PCM to Rust only when recording stops. It never starts/stops a capture, reads a media file, exposes a path, or persists a fact. A completed capture or server restart returns not_found rather than inferring state from artifacts.

capture_id.description: The exact active capture id returned by screen_record.start. It is an opaque identifier, never a path.

verbs.result: {capture_id, ready, terminal, state:"awaiting_first_screen_frame"|"ready"|"terminal_before_first_screen_frame"|"terminal_after_first_screen_frame", source_lifecycle:{state:"awaiting_first_frame"|"active"|"terminal"|"source_lost"|"unavailable",reason}, controller_placement:{state:"excluded"|"auto_hidden"|"refused"|"unavailable",reason}, audio_meters:{microphone,system_audio}}. source_lifecycle:source_lost is a native selected-source close observation; terminal is not relabelled as source loss and unavailable makes no close-observation claim. Each audio source is {state:"not_requested"|"awaiting_samples"|"live"|"stale"|"device_lost"|"stopped"|"unavailable", peak_dbfs|null, rms_dbfs|null, decayed_peak_dbfs|null, sample_age_ms|null, stale, clipping, detail?}; only state:live with stale:false is a current level. proceed only when ready:true and terminal:false. not_found means that no matching capture is active in this cutd process.
